title: TensorTransit Frontier Receipt
description: The permanent, machine-readable evidence artifact for one authoritative evaluation. It has to answer, years later and without the box that produced it: which generation, which baseline, which candidate, on what hardware, under what runtime, against what model, with what correctness result, at what confidence, and how much frontier was created.

generation_checksum.description: The generation this was scored under, hashed. A generation is frozen; if its meaning changed, the answer is a new TTF-N and not an edit, and this is what makes that enforceable rather than promised.

mode.description: `authoritative` is the trusted evaluator's run; `public` is a contributor iterating locally.

instances.description: Whether the generation's workload instances are public or hidden. TTF-1's are public, and its generation.json says why rather than pretending otherwise.

correctness_compared_against.description: Which build produced the control replays. `baseline build` means the gate asked whether the SUBMISSION changes the model's output; `candidate build` means it only asked whether enabling the policy does, which a submission whose inert path changed the output would pass.

gain_percent.description: What was MEASURED. Recorded whatever the status, so a CORRECTNESS_FAIL is debuggable.

verified_gain_percent.description: What the ledger CREDITS. Zero unless the status is FRONTIER_GAIN.

cell_objectives.description: The frozen bounds each cell was actually scored under. Without them a reader cannot reproduce a hypervolume from the raw results, and a receipt that cannot be reproduced is a claim rather than evidence.

cells_at_floor.description: Cells whose hypervolume was zero for an arm and were scored at the floor instead. One such cell can move dF by a large multiple through the geometric mean, so it is named rather than absorbed.

partial.description: True when the generation declares a cell this run did not measure. A hole is named, never renormalised away.

failures.description: Measurements that produced no operating point, by variant and reason. A run that lost a region says so.

seed.description: Frozen, so the receipt is reproducible bit for bit from its raw results.

status.description: Evaluation STATE. None of these categorizes impact magnitude: there are no XS/S/M/L/XL bands anywhere in this system, and frontier/README.md says why.

content_digest.description: SHA-256 over every scored field. `tt-frontier receipt verify` recomputes it, which is what turns 'a finalized receipt is never silently rewritten' from a rule into a check.
